statement: Samsung aims to raise its HBM market share by year-end 2026 to roughly the level of its overall DRAM share, about 38%.
why: A share shift toward a second large supplier changes the bargaining position of accelerator buyers on the scarcest input.

impact.mechanism: If Samsung's HBM share converges on its ~38% DRAM share, HBM supply becomes less concentrated, improving availability and pricing leverage for accelerator makers.

evidence.excerpt: raising its HBM market share by year-end to a level similar to its overall DRAM market share of about 38%

confidence.basis: Secondary trade press reporting a company target, not an audited share figure; the 38% is the stated DRAM share used as the target level.
